name: OpenAQ Explorer
description: Map of PM2.5, PM10, ozone, NO2, SO2, and CO from reference monitors and low-cost sensors worldwide, backed by an open aggregation platform and free API. The open counterpart to IQAir, with a plainer interface.
embedNote: Site sends a frame-blocking header, so the preview opens in a new tab

Software Licensing.note: Open source under the OpenAQ GitHub organisation

Data Licensing.note: Aggregates open air quality data under open terms

Technical Accessibility.note: Web app plus a free documented API

Infrastructure.note: Nonprofit hosted; platform code can be self-hosted
